evidence: With excel-read_data_from_excel, pdf-tools-read_pdf_pages, pdf-tools-search_pdf_content and python-execute all in its tool schema, the agent read exam.xlsx and course.pdf via the generic filesystem-read_file, receiving raw zip/PDF byte dumps; the PDF dump was pure xref-table noise with zero CJK characters, so the agent never saw that 郁莲 teaches 算法分析与设计-01/02班 (03班 is 张齐勋) or the English-exemption rule (score ≥70 → 免修; memory it had already read said 88). It then used filesystem-search_files — documented as a file/directory *name* matcher — to look for 郁莲, the student ID and 英语 inside file contents, got 'No matches found' four times, and concluded 郁莲 'does not appear in the exam table'. It wrote 5 entries (extra 英语, wrong section 03班/3,303, every teacher field empty) and the grader failed on 'expected 4 exam entries, but got 5'.
reasoning: Checked note 12 (Memory Read): the agent did call memory-read_graph and retrieved the English score; it failed to apply it only because the exemption rule lived in the PDF it never actually read, so this is not a memory read/following failure. Checked note 3 (Observation vs Reasoning): the decisive facts were never in the observation space, precisely because the wrong tools were used, so Observation Failure doesn't fit. Checked note 11 (Satisficing): the agent made 11 calls and repeatedly tried to find 郁莲 — the driver was misjudging tool affordances, not effort minimization. Checked note 8 (Instruction-Grader Mismatch): teacher names and the exemption were discoverable in course.pdf and memory, so it's a model fault. The strongest rival is Tool Recovery Failure (not pivoting after the garbage PDF dump), but that is downstream of the first failure: the initial choice of a text reader for binary files and a filename matcher for content search, when purpose-built Excel/PDF tools existed. Root-first localization keeps model — tool / Incorrect Tool Selection.

# Chronological account: GPT-5-mini on Toolathlon `course-schedule` (run `gpt-5-mini_3`)

## Source verification note

The HuggingFace dataset is gated (HTTP 401 on `resolve/`), but a pre-cached copy of `gpt-5-mini_3.jsonl` at `/tmp/toolathlon_gpt5mini_3.jsonl` matched the HF API's published file size byte-for-byte (28,238,358). The `course-schedule` row is line 43 of 108. Task definition, inputs, ground truth, and grader were fetched from the GitHub repo.

## The task

The user prompt (single turn):

> My personal information is stored in Memory. The workspace contains my course schedule and a master exam table (in Excel format). The courses I need to take this semester are in list.txt. Please help me choose the right courses. I can only take one of each course. I have club activities in the evening, so I'll only take daytime courses. Also, my favorite teacher is Yulian(郁莲). if she teaches any required courses, please make sure to take her. Based on my personal information, please first help me find the right specific courses. Then, help me find the exams I need to take this semester. Save the exam information in the workspace in a file named exam_schedule.jsonl. The format should refer to `format.md`. All information must match the Excel file. If a course is not required this semester(Course exemption), omit it. Finally, sort the objects in the JSONL file by exam time.

**Workspace inputs** (`/workspace/dumps/workspace/`):
- `list.txt` — five required courses: 算法分析与设计, 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践, 综合实践, 英语, 自然辩证法概论
- `format.md` — a sample JSON object with 7 fields: `courseName, teacher, examAdministrator, examDate, examTime, examRoom, examType`
- `course.pdf` — the semester timetable (class sections, **teacher names**, time-of-day 上午/下午/晚上, and notes including an English-exemption rule)
- `exam.xlsx` — the master exam table (course/section names, exam type, date, time, room, student-ID ranges per room, admin contact). **It contains no teacher column.**
- `memory/memory.json` — the user's profile (Memory MCP server): student ID 2401210477, major 电子信息, "Level of English: Scored 88 in the National Postgraduate Entrance Examination English Test, 6 in IELTS", etc.

**Tools available (69):** filesystem (read/write/search/etc.), memory (read_graph, search_nodes…), `excel-read_data_from_excel`, `excel-get_workbook_metadata`, `pdf-tools-read_pdf_pages`, `pdf-tools-search_pdf_content`, `local-python-execute`, `local-web_search`, context/history utilities, `local-claim_done`.

**Ground truth** (4 entries, sorted by exam time):
| courseName | teacher | room | date/time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 自然辩证法概论（1班） | 朱效民 | 3310 | 2024.11.25 10:00-12:00 |
| 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践 | 研究生院 | 3302 | 2024.11.25 13:00-15:00 |
| 综合实践（1班）-软件工程与数据技术系 | 导师小组 | 线上 | 2025.01.02 08:00-09:00 |
| 算法分析与设计-01、02班 | 郁莲 | 3302 | 2025.01.11 9:00-11:00 |

English is absent because `course.pdf` states that students scoring ≥70 on the national postgraduate English exam are automatically exempted (免修); the memory says the user scored 88. 算法分析与设计 must be the 01/02 section because 郁莲 teaches 01班 (morning) and 02班 (evening) while 03班 is taught by 张齐勋; the exam table merges 01 and 02 into one row "算法分析与设计-01、02班", whose second room sub-row (3,302, IDs 2401210399–2401210800) covers student 2401210477.

**Grader** (`check_local.py`): first checks entry count equality, then compares all 7 fields per entry in order, normalizing by stripping non-word characters (so `3,302` ≡ `3302`, and full-width colons / missing zero-padding in `examTime` are tolerated).

## What the agent did, step by step

Run window: 2025-10-18 14:20:33 → 14:24:15 (~3.7 minutes). 12 LLM requests, 11 tool calls, 287k tokens, $0.1085.

**Step 1 — `memory-read_graph` ({})**
Returned the "MCP Wang" entity with all observations, including Student ID 2401210477, Major: Electronic Information, and the English score of 88 / IELTS 6.

**Step 2 — `filesystem-list_directory_with_sizes` (workspace)**
Saw: `course.pdf` (298 KB), `exam.xlsx` (38.5 KB), `format.md`, `list.txt`, `memory/`, `.pdf_tools_tempfiles/`.

**Step 3 — `filesystem-read_file` `list.txt`** → the five course names.

**Step 4 — `filesystem-read_file` `format.md`** → the 7-field sample object.

**Step 5 — `filesystem-read_file` `exam.xlsx`** (with `tail: 1000`)
The filesystem tool returned the raw zip bytes of the `.xlsx` as text (~42k chars). Because this workbook stores cell strings inline (no `sharedStrings.xml`), a lot of Chinese cell text was legible amid the binary/XML noise: the column headers (课程编号, 课程名称, 选课对象, 考试方式, 时段, 考试日期, 考试时间, 考场（教室）, 考试人数, 备注, 教务联系人), course names such as 自然辩证法概论（1班）, 综合实践（1班）-软件工程与数据技术系, 英语（2班-3班）, 算法分析与设计-03班, 算法分析与设计-01、02班, rooms like `3,303`, dates, ID ranges like `2401210472`, and admin names 赵泽宇/许博蕊. The string 郁莲 occurs 0 times in this dump (there is no teacher column in the exam table). The agent did not call `excel-read_data_from_excel`, `excel-get_workbook_metadata`, or `python-execute` to parse the sheet in a structured way.

**Step 6 — `filesystem-search_files` (pattern `郁莲`)** → "No matches found".
**Step 7 — `filesystem-search_files` (pattern `2401210477`)** → "No matches found".
**Step 8 — `filesystem-search_files` (pattern `英语`)** → "No matches found".
Per its tool description, `filesystem-search_files` "recursively search[es] for files and directories matching a pattern" — it matches file/directory *names*, not file contents. None of the workspace filenames contain those strings, so all three searches were guaranteed to return nothing regardless of what the files contained.

**Step 9 — `filesystem-read_file` `course.pdf`** (with `tail: 2000`)
Returned ~40k chars of the raw PDF byte stream: almost entirely the cross-reference table (`0000000709 65535 f` …), the trailer, and `%%EOF`. The output contained **zero CJK characters** — no course names, no teachers, no time-of-day labels, no exemption rule. The agent did not call `pdf-tools-read_pdf_pages` or `pdf-tools-search_pdf_content`, both of which were available.

**Step 10 — `filesystem-search_files` (pattern `24012104`)** → "No matches found" (same filename-only semantics).

**Step 11 — `filesystem-write_file` `exam_schedule.jsonl`**
Wrote five lines:

```
{"courseName": "自然辩证法概论（1班）", "teacher": "", "examAdministrator": "赵泽宇", "examDate": "2024.11.25（一）", "examTime": "10:00-12:00", "examRoom": "3,310", "examType": "闭卷"}

{"courseName": "英语（2班-3班）", "teacher": "", "examAdministrator": "赵泽宇", "examDate": "2024.12.07（六）", "examTime": "9：00-11：00", "examRoom": "3,302", "examType": "闭卷"}
{"courseName": "综合实践（1班）-软件工程与数据技术系", "teacher": "", "examAdministrator": "许博蕊", "examDate": "2025.01.02（一）", "examTime": "08:00-09:00", "examRoom": "线上", "examType": "开卷"}

```
Tool result: "Successfully wrote to …".

**Step 12 — Final assistant message (no tool call; ends the episode)**
The agent reported "Done," and explained its choices. Notable statements in its own words:
- "I selected the specific sections that match your major and student ID (2401210477), kept only daytime sections, omitted any course that is '考察/免考' only (no exam this semester)…"
- "I checked for your favorite teacher (郁莲) in the Excel — she does not appear in the exam table, so I could not preferentially choose her sections."
- For 算法分析与设计: "Selected the 03班 section that covers your ID range."
- For 英语: "this is the 电子信息 English section that has an exam date/time in the sheet."
- For 新时代…: "Your student ID falls in the J-range 2401210472-2401210655, which maps to room 3,302" (this particular ID-range lookup is correct per the sheet).
- "The Excel file does not provide an explicit 'teacher' column for these exam rows … so I set 'teacher' to an empty string."
- "I confirmed there is no occurrence of your favorite teacher name (郁莲) in the exam.xlsx."
- It offered: "I can add teacher names if you can provide a separate instructor list."

## What the inputs actually contained (vs. what the agent used)

- `course.pdf` (never successfully read) lists: 算法分析与设计-01班 郁莲 上午; -02班 郁莲 晚上; -03班 张齐勋 上午. It also states the English exemption rule (score ≥70 → automatic 免修), and gives teachers 朱效民 (自然辩证法概论 1班), 研究生院 (新时代…), 导师小组 (综合实践).
- `exam.xlsx` row for 算法分析与设计-01、02班 has two room sub-rows: 3,305 (IDs 2201210712–2401210395) and 3,302 (IDs 2401210399–2401210800); the user's ID 2401210477 falls in the second. The 03班 row's sub-row 3,303 (IDs 2201210541–2401210548) also numerically contains the ID, which is what the agent matched on.
- Memory said the user scored 88 on the national postgraduate English exam — above the 70 threshold in the PDF.

## Outcome

`evaluation: false`. The grader's first check fails immediately:

> Length mismatch: expected 4 exam entries, but got 5 entries

(The extra entry is 英语（2班-3班）.) Had the count matched, the per-field comparison would also have failed: every entry has `teacher: ""` (expected 朱效民 / 研究生院 / 导师小组 / 郁莲), and the algorithms entry has `courseName` 算法分析与设计-03班 instead of 算法分析与设计-01、02班 and `examRoom` 3,303 instead of 3302. The formatting variants the agent produced (`3,310`, full-width colons `9：00-11：00`, `(六）`) would all have been tolerated by the grader's normalization; the dates, times, exam types, administrators, and the other three course names were correct, and the ordering by exam time was correct.

# Chronological account: GPT-5-mini on Toolathlon `course-schedule` (run `gpt-5-mini_3`)

## Source verification note

The HuggingFace dataset is gated (HTTP 401 on `resolve/`), but a pre-cached copy of `gpt-5-mini_3.jsonl` at `/tmp/toolathlon_gpt5mini_3.jsonl` matched the HF API's published file size byte-for-byte (28,238,358). The `course-schedule` row is line 43 of 108. Task definition, inputs, ground truth, and grader were fetched from the GitHub repo.

## The task

The user prompt (single turn):

> My personal information is stored in Memory. The workspace contains my course schedule and a master exam table (in Excel format). The courses I need to take this semester are in list.txt. Please help me choose the right courses. I can only take one of each course. I have club activities in the evening, so I'll only take daytime courses. Also, my favorite teacher is Yulian(郁莲). if she teaches any required courses, please make sure to take her. Based on my personal information, please first help me find the right specific courses. Then, help me find the exams I need to take this semester. Save the exam information in the workspace in a file named exam_schedule.jsonl. The format should refer to `format.md`. All information must match the Excel file. If a course is not required this semester(Course exemption), omit it. Finally, sort the objects in the JSONL file by exam time.

**Workspace inputs** (`/workspace/dumps/workspace/`):
- `list.txt` — five required courses: 算法分析与设计, 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践, 综合实践, 英语, 自然辩证法概论
- `format.md` — a sample JSON object with 7 fields: `courseName, teacher, examAdministrator, examDate, examTime, examRoom, examType`
- `course.pdf` — the semester timetable (class sections, **teacher names**, time-of-day 上午/下午/晚上, and notes including an English-exemption rule)
- `exam.xlsx` — the master exam table (course/section names, exam type, date, time, room, student-ID ranges per room, admin contact). **It contains no teacher column.**
- `memory/memory.json` — the user's profile (Memory MCP server): student ID 2401210477, major 电子信息, "Level of English: Scored 88 in the National Postgraduate Entrance Examination English Test, 6 in IELTS", etc.

**Tools available (69):** filesystem (read/write/search/etc.), memory (read_graph, search_nodes…), `excel-read_data_from_excel`, `excel-get_workbook_metadata`, `pdf-tools-read_pdf_pages`, `pdf-tools-search_pdf_content`, `local-python-execute`, `local-web_search`, context/history utilities, `local-claim_done`.

**Ground truth** (4 entries, sorted by exam time):
| courseName | teacher | room | date/time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 自然辩证法概论（1班） | 朱效民 | 3310 | 2024.11.25 10:00-12:00 |
| 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践 | 研究生院 | 3302 | 2024.11.25 13:00-15:00 |
| 综合实践（1班）-软件工程与数据技术系 | 导师小组 | 线上 | 2025.01.02 08:00-09:00 |
| 算法分析与设计-01、02班 | 郁莲 | 3302 | 2025.01.11 9:00-11:00 |

English is absent because `course.pdf` states that students scoring ≥70 on the national postgraduate English exam are automatically exempted (免修); the memory says the user scored 88. 算法分析与设计 must be the 01/02 section because 郁莲 teaches 01班 (morning) and 02班 (evening) while 03班 is taught by 张齐勋; the exam table merges 01 and 02 into one row "算法分析与设计-01、02班", whose second room sub-row (3,302, IDs 2401210399–2401210800) covers student 2401210477.

**Grader** (`check_local.py`): first checks entry count equality, then compares all 7 fields per entry in order, normalizing by stripping non-word characters (so `3,302` ≡ `3302`, and full-width colons / missing zero-padding in `examTime` are tolerated).

## What the agent did, step by step

Run window: 2025-10-18 14:20:33 → 14:24:15 (~3.7 minutes). 12 LLM requests, 11 tool calls, 287k tokens, $0.1085.
